page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.3xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. Computing resources are supplied by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz, providing 12 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration delivers 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high-density allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Storage and acceleration boundaries are clearly defined, as the instance includes no local disk storage and zero discrete GPUs. Operating system disks and persistent file systems must rely on external network-attached volumes. Networking interfaces provide a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the server.

Given the 1:8 compute-to-memory proportion, this configuration balances memory capacity against compute resources for cost efficiency in memory-heavy scenarios. The server is well suited for memory-intensive workloads, including distributed caching services, in-memory databases, large-scale Java enterprise applications, and memory-bound ETL processing pipelines.
